title.zh: 三维人体解剖
title.en: 3D human anatomy

title.zh: 一具可以一层层剥开的身体
title.en: A body you can peel layer by layer

hint.zh: 拖动下方滑块，从皮肤一层层剥到骨骼；拖动旋转，点一下之后可用滚轮缩放。首次加载约 20 MB
hint.en: Drag the slider to peel from skin down to bone; drag to rotate, click once to enable wheel zoom. The first load is about 20 MB

title.zh: 只看骨骼
title.en: The skeleton alone

hint.zh: 点任意一块骨看名称；双击聚焦。只下载骨骼（约 2.5 MB），加载很快
hint.en: Click any bone for its name; double-click to focus. Only the skeleton is fetched (about 2.5 MB), so it loads fast

title.zh: 骨架上的神经
title.en: Nerves on the skeleton

hint.zh: 神经只有零点几毫米粗：指针靠近就能选中，不必正好点在线上。试着沿坐骨神经一路点下去
hint.en: Nerves are a fraction of a millimetre thick: the pointer only has to come near one to pick it. Try following the sciatic nerve down the leg

title.zh: 一块肌肉的起止点和神经支配
title.en: One muscle: origin, insertion, innervation

hint.zh: 已选中左肱二头肌长头。在完整界面里可以看到它的起点、止点、支配神经和血供，逐个点开
hint.en: The long head of the left biceps is selected. Open the full UI to see its origin, insertion, nerve and blood supply, each one clickable

title.zh: 横断胸部
title.en: A cut through the thorax

hint.zh: 拖动“剖切”滑块上下移动切面，切口按组织填色：看心、肺、大血管在胸腔里的位置关系
hint.en: Drag the section slider to move the cut; the cut faces are filled by tissue. See how heart, lungs and great vessels sit in the chest

title.zh: 皮节图
title.en: Dermatome map

hint.zh: 鼠标移到皮肤上看是哪一节脊神经的皮节，点一下高亮。这是教学示意图，边界因人而异
hint.en: Hover the skin to see which spinal segment supplies it, click to highlight. A teaching diagram: real boundaries vary between people

title.zh: 正中神经和它管的皮肤
title.en: The median nerve and the skin it supplies

hint.zh: 皮肤半透明，能看到正中神经一路走到手掌，以及它支配的那片皮肤。切换到“皮节”对比两种分区
hint.en: The skin is see-through: follow the median nerve to the palm and the patch of skin it supplies. Switch to dermatomes to compare the two maps

title.zh: 摆姿势：深蹲
title.en: Posed: deep squat

hint.zh: 进来会自己蹲下。点下方按钮换别的姿势；这是纯运动学演示，深屈时软组织会互相穿插
hint.en: It squats by itself. Use the buttons for other poses; this is kinematics only, so soft tissue interpenetrates in deep flexion

title.zh: 屈肘时的上臂肌肉
title.en: Arm muscles as the elbow bends

hint.zh: 屈肘 90°，已选中肱二头肌：看它随关节变短变粗。点“静止”再点“屈肘”反复对比
hint.en: Elbow at 90° with the biceps selected: watch it shorten and thicken. Toggle between rest and the flexed pose to compare

title.zh: 托住前臂：哪些肌肉在用力（估计）
title.en: Holding the forearm up: which muscles work (an estimate)

hint.zh: 屈肘 90°，颜色越暖越亮表示估计的激活度越高：肱二头肌亮起，肱三头肌是灰的。这是静力优化的估计，不是肌电图；在完整界面的“姿势”页里可以勾“手持重物”看它变强
hint.en: Elbow at 90°; warmer and brighter means a higher estimated activation: the biceps lights up while the triceps stays grey. A static-optimisation estimate, not an EMG; in the full UI the Pose tab has a "Holding" box that makes it stronger

title.zh: 平举手臂：三角肌托住上肢（估计）
title.en: Arm held out sideways: the deltoid carries the limb (an estimate)

hint.zh: 肩外展 90°：三角肌中束亮起。模型里冈上肌几乎不亮——直线作用线在抬臂后没有外展力臂，这是已知的缺陷
hint.en: Shoulder abducted 90°: the middle deltoid lights up. Supraspinatus stays almost dark in the model: a straight line of action has no abduction moment arm once the arm is raised, a known defect

title.zh: 浅蹲：股四头肌撑住膝（估计）
title.en: Shallow squat: the quadriceps hold the knees (an estimate)

hint.zh: 屈膝 60°、躯干前倾：股四头肌最亮，腘绳肌作为伸髋肌也在用力，小腿和竖脊肌参与。图例下方若出现 ⚠，说明这个姿势下有的关节肌肉给不出所需力矩
hint.en: Knees at 60° with the trunk leaning forward: the quadriceps are brightest, the hamstrings work as hip extensors, calf and erector spinae join in. A ⚠ under the legend means the muscles cannot deliver the torque some joint needs in this pose

title.zh: 呼吸时的胸廓
title.en: The rib cage breathing

hint.zh: 各肋循环上提和下降。从侧面和上方看，下位肋像桶柄一样向外张开
hint.en: The ribs rise and fall in a cycle. From the side and from above, the lower ribs swing out like bucket handles

title.zh: 心脏和大血管
title.en: The heart and great vessels

hint.zh: 只显示心脏、主动脉、肺动脉干和腔静脉。点任意一部分看名称，拖动转到背面看肺静脉入口
hint.en: Only the heart, aorta, pulmonary trunk and venae cavae are shown. Click any part for its name; turn it round to see where the veins enter

title.zh: 膝关节：从上方看半月板和韧带
title.en: The knee from above: menisci and ligaments

hint.zh: 已隐去股骨和髌骨，只留胫骨、腓骨、膝关节的韧带和半月板。从上往下看胫骨平台：两块半月板、前后交叉韧带，逐个点一点
hint.en: Femur and patella are hidden; tibia, fibula and the knee ligaments and menisci remain. Look down on the tibial plateau: two menisci and the two cruciate ligaments — click each

title.zh: 疼痛表情：皱眉、挤眼、张口
title.en: The pain expression: brow, eyes and mouth

hint.zh: 拖动强度滑块看皱眉、挤眼、提上唇逐步出现；点“触发”看它按时间出现又消退；眼和口是真正的开口，“看肌肉”可以对照肌肉。声音默认关，打开后再触发才会出声。这是行为的计算模型，模拟人没有感受
hint.en: Drag the intensity slider to see brow lowering, eye tightening and lip raising appear step by step; Trigger plays the time course; eyes and mouth are real openings, and “看肌肉” compares the muscles. Sound is off by default and plays only after you turn it on and trigger. A computational model of behaviour: the simulated body feels nothing

title.zh: 女性盆底：从上方看盆膈
title.en: The female pelvic floor from above

hint.zh: 只显示髋骨、骶骨、盆膈和会阴的肌肉。从上往下看：耻骨直肠肌像吊带一样绕过直肠后方。逐块点一点；这些肌肉是按文献建模后配准的，不是她本人的扫描
hint.en: Hip bones, sacrum and the muscles of the pelvic diaphragm and perineum only. Looking down: puborectalis slings round behind the rectum. Click each muscle; they are modelled from the literature and registered, not scanned from her

title.zh: 女性下肢肌肉：数据从哪来
title.en: The female leg muscles: where the data comes from

hint.zh: 按来源着色：不同颜色是不同的数据集。点任意一块肌肉，在完整界面里可以看到它的来源、许可和“配准变形”的含义
hint.en: Coloured by source: each colour is a different dataset. Click any muscle; the full UI shows its source, licence and what “warped” means

title.zh: 女性：皮节图
title.en: Female: dermatome map

hint.zh: 鼠标移到皮肤上看是哪一节脊神经的皮节，点一下高亮；切换到“皮神经”对比。教学示意图，躯干处分区较粗
hint.en: Hover the skin to see which spinal segment supplies it, click to highlight; switch to nerve territories to compare. A teaching diagram, rough on the trunk

title.zh: 女性：深蹲
title.en: Female: deep squat

hint.zh: 进来会自己蹲下，点下方按钮换别的姿势。纯运动学演示：深屈时软组织会互相穿插
hint.en: She squats by herself; use the buttons for other poses. Kinematics only: soft tissue interpenetrates in deep flexion

title.zh: 女性：疼痛表情
title.en: Female: the pain expression

hint.zh: 拖动强度、点“触发”；点“看皮肤”对比肌肉和皮肤上的表情。行为的计算模型，模拟人没有感受；声音默认关
hint.en: Drag the intensity, press Trigger; “看皮肤” compares the expression on muscle and on skin. A computational model of behaviour — the simulated body feels nothing; sound is off by default

title.zh: 一张高兴的脸：哪些肌肉在动
title.en: A happy face: which muscles are at work

hint.zh: 下方可以换一种情绪（6 种基本、15 种复合）并调强度。动作单元的组合取自 Du 等 2014，强度是假设；模拟人没有情绪
hint.en: Pick another emotion below (6 basic, 15 compound) and change its strength. The action-unit sets are from Du et al. 2014 and the intensities are assumptions; the simulated body has no emotions

title.zh: 女性：恐惧的表情
title.en: Female: a fearful expression

hint.zh: 眉内侧上抬并聚拢、上睑提起、口角横拉。把强度拉到一半再看；换成“惊讶”比较两者的眉和口
hint.en: Inner brows raised and drawn together, upper lids lifted, lip corners stretched sideways. Halve the strength, then switch to “surprised” and compare brows and mouth

title.zh: 说话的口形：双唇音合上，再换成开口的 a
title.en: Mouth shapes of speech: lips sealed for p b m, then an open a

hint.zh: 现在保持的是 p b m：下颌微开而两唇合拢。在下方把口形换成“开口 a”，能看到牙和舌；共 22 个口形；这里用的是夸张风格，数值是假设（正常朗读的开度按实测标定，小得多）
hint.en: Held now is p b m: the jaw slightly open with the lips sealed. Switch the mouth shape below to “open a” to see teeth and tongue; 22 shapes in all; the exaggerated style is shown here and its numbers are assumptions (the openings of normal read speech are calibrated against measurements and far smaller)

title.zh: 说一句英语：口形跟着音素走
title.en: An English sentence: the mouth follows the phonemes

hint.zh: “Please bring five more books before noon tomorrow.” 看 p、b、m 处两唇合上，f、v 处下唇碰上齿。进来时无声地循环，点“声音”带声音播一遍。声音是机器合成的（Kokoro，Apache-2.0）；开口度是实测的朗读幅度，只有几毫米；模拟人并没有在说话
hint.en: “Please bring five more books before noon tomorrow.” Watch the lips meet at p, b and m and the lower lip touch the teeth at f and v. It loops silently on arrival; press “Sound” to hear it once. The audio is machine-synthesized (Kokoro, Apache-2.0); the openings are those measured in read speech, a few millimetres only; the simulated body is not speaking

title.zh: 女性：说一句普通话：ü 和卷舌音
title.en: Female: a Mandarin sentence: ü and the retroflex initials

hint.zh: “小朋友们在学校里学习写字、唱歌。”“学”的 ü 撮圆了唇，“唱”的 ch 卷舌而不圆唇。进来时无声地循环，点“声音”带声音播一遍。声音是机器合成的（Kokoro，Apache-2.0）；普通话专用的口形没有实测数据，是假设
hint.en: “小朋友们在学校里学习写字、唱歌。” The ü of 学 rounds the lips, and the ch of 唱 curls the tongue without rounding them. It loops silently on arrival; press “Sound” to hear it once. The audio is machine-synthesized (Kokoro, Apache-2.0); the Mandarin-only shapes have no measurements behind them and are assumptions

title.zh: 同一句话，正常的和夸张的口形
title.en: One sentence, normal and exaggerated mouth shapes

hint.zh: “Put the blue cup on the top shelf, above the bread.” 现在是“夸张”：校准之前的大口形，数值是假设。在下方换成“正常”：按电磁发音仪实测的切牙开度标定，开口的元音也只有约 5 毫米。点“声音”带声音播（机器合成）
hint.en: “Put the blue cup on the top shelf, above the bread.” Shown now is “Clear”: the wide shapes from before calibration, whose numbers are assumptions. Switch to “Normal” below: calibrated against incisor openings measured by electromagnetic articulography, where even an open vowel is only about 5 mm. Press “Sound” to hear it (machine-synthesized)

title.zh: 真人朗读：口形按音素走
title.en: Real read speech: the mouth follows the phonemes

hint.zh: LibriSpeech 里一位男性读“To ride over salt water upon the back of a little horse seemed to me absurd.” 口形由音素时间线带动：b、p、m 处两唇合上，v 处下唇碰上齿。进来时无声地循环，点“声音”听录音；在下方换成“按音频”对比。录音 CC BY 4.0（LibriSpeech，LibriVox 公有领域有声书）；时间线是自动对齐（Montreal Forced Aligner），不是人工标注
hint.en: A male reader from LibriSpeech: “To ride over salt water upon the back of a little horse seemed to me absurd.” The phoneme timeline drives the mouth: the lips meet at b, p and m and the lower lip touches the teeth at v. It loops silently on arrival; press “Sound” to hear the recording, and switch to “By audio” below to compare. Recording CC BY 4.0 (LibriSpeech, from LibriVox public-domain audiobooks); the timeline is an automatic alignment (Montreal Forced Aligner), not hand labels

title.zh: 同一句真人朗读，口形只按声音分析
title.en: The same real recording, the mouth from audio analysis alone

hint.zh: 同一句录音，这次口形只从声音里分析出来，不知道是哪个音：开口大致跟着响度和元音走，但双唇音几乎合不上，唇齿音也没有。在下方换回“按音素”对比；两种方式的对比数值（下颌角相关、双唇音处的唇间隙）写在示例包的 manifest.json 里。录音 CC BY 4.0（LibriSpeech）
hint.en: The same recording, now with the mouth analysed from the sound alone, without knowing which sound is which: the opening roughly follows loudness and the vowels, but the bilabials hardly close and there are no labiodentals. Switch back to “By phoneme” below to compare; the numbers comparing the two modes (jaw-angle correlation, lip gap at the bilabials) are in the example pack's manifest.json. Recording CC BY 4.0 (LibriSpeech)

title.zh: 肌肉视图里的愤怒：皱眉肌和降眉间肌
title.en: Anger in the muscle view: corrugator and procerus

hint.zh: 去掉皮肤看表情肌怎样移动：眉头被拉向中间和下方，下睑收紧，双唇压紧。点“看皮肤”对照表面
hint.en: The skin is off so the muscles of expression can be watched: the brows drawn inwards and down, the lower lids tightened, the lips pressed. Press “Skin” to compare with the surface

title.zh: 胖瘦：只有皮肤和皮下脂肪在变
title.en: Fatness: only the skin and the fat under it change

hint.zh: 拖动 BMI 滑块。肌肉、骨和内脏不变，内脏脂肪没有模拟；到下限时会说明原因。回归公式给出的是人群平均，不是对某个人的预测
hint.en: Drag the BMI slider. Muscles, bones and viscera stay as they are and visceral fat is not modelled; at the lower limit the reason is shown. The regressions give population averages, not a prediction for a person

title.zh: 身高与比例：骨和肌肉一起变长
title.en: Stature and proportions: bones and muscles lengthen together

hint.zh: 拖动身高滑块，看各节段按人体测量回归的比例缩放。缩短时皮下脂肪最多会穿出皮肤约 12 毫米
hint.en: Drag the stature slider and watch the segments scale by anthropometric regressions. When shortened, subcutaneous fat comes through the skin by up to about 12 mm

title.zh: 女性：胖瘦与身高
title.en: Female: fatness and stature

hint.zh: 拖动 BMI 和身高滑块。乳房和内脏脂肪不随 BMI 变
hint.en: Drag the BMI and stature sliders. The breasts and visceral fat do not follow BMI

title.zh: 针刺示指尖：冲动沿正中神经走到颈髓
title.en: Pinprick to the index fingertip: the volley runs up the median nerve to the cervical cord

hint.zh: 看两个标记：Aδ 纤维的冲动先到，C 纤维的晚到。换一种刺激再点“触发”。计算模型，模拟人没有主观体验；标为“假设”的数不是测量值；声音默认关
hint.en: Watch the two markers: the Aδ volley arrives first, the C volley later. Pick another kind and press Trigger. A computational model — the simulated body has no subjective experience; numbers marked “assumption” are not measurements; sound is off by default

title.zh: 前臂接触 48 °C：退缩反射把刺激缩短
title.en: 48 °C on the forearm: the withdrawal reflex cuts the stimulus short

hint.zh: 手臂在表情出现之前就缩回；监护条上“若持续”与实际到达的强度不同。计算模型，模拟人没有主观体验；标为“假设”的数不是测量值；声音默认关
hint.en: The arm withdraws before the face responds; on the monitor the level “if held” differs from the level reached. A computational model — the simulated body has no subjective experience; numbers marked “assumption” are not measurements; sound is off by default

title.zh: 手掌浸在 4 °C 里一分钟（手被固定）
title.en: Palm in 4 °C for a minute (hand held in place)

hint.zh: 手不能缩回，强度按时长发展；看心率、血压、瞳孔和皮肤电导各自多快变化、多久回到基线。这些是群体平均的效应量。计算模型，模拟人没有主观体验；标为“假设”的数不是测量值；声音默认关
hint.en: The hand cannot withdraw, so the intensity follows the duration; see how fast heart rate, blood pressure, pupil and skin conductance change and return. These are group-average effect sizes. A computational model — the simulated body has no subjective experience; numbers marked “assumption” are not measurements; sound is off by default

title.zh: 捏夹足底：下肢的屈曲退缩
title.en: Pinch on the sole: flexion withdrawal of the lower limb

hint.zh: 通路从足底经胫神经、坐骨神经到腰骶髓；把量值调到阈值以下再触发，什么都不会发生。计算模型，模拟人没有主观体验；标为“假设”的数不是测量值；声音默认关
hint.en: The pathway runs from the sole through the tibial and sciatic nerves to the lumbosacral cord; set the magnitude below threshold and trigger again: nothing happens. A computational model — the simulated body has no subjective experience; numbers marked “assumption” are not measurements; sound is off by default

title.zh: 女性：针刺示指尖：冲动沿正中神经走到颈髓
title.en: Female: Pinprick to the index fingertip: the volley runs up the median nerve to the cervical cord

hint.zh: 看两个标记：Aδ 纤维的冲动先到，C 纤维的晚到。换一种刺激再点“触发”。计算模型，模拟人没有主观体验；标为“假设”的数不是测量值；声音默认关

title.en: Female: 48 °C on the forearm: the withdrawal reflex cuts the stimulus short

hint.zh: 手臂在表情出现之前就缩回；监护条上“若持续”与实际到达的强度不同。计算模型，模拟人没有主观体验；标为“假设”的数不是测量值；声音默认关

title.zh: 女性：手掌浸在 4 °C 里一分钟（手被固定）
title.en: Female: Palm in 4 °C for a minute (hand held in place)

hint.zh: 手不能缩回，强度按时长发展；看心率、血压、瞳孔和皮肤电导各自多快变化、多久回到基线。这些是群体平均的效应量。计算模型，模拟人没有主观体验；标为“假设”的数不是测量值；声音默认关

A computational model — the simulated body has no subjective experience; numbers marked “assumption” are not measurements; sound is off by default

title.zh: 女性：捏夹足底：下肢的屈曲退缩
title.en: Female: Pinch on the sole: flexion withdrawal of the lower limb

hint.zh: 通路从足底经胫神经、坐骨神经到腰骶髓；把量值调到阈值以下再触发，什么都不会发生。计算模型，模拟人没有主观体验；标为“假设”的数不是测量值；声音默认关

title.zh: 按压前臂：软组织求解出的凹陷和接触压强
title.en: Pressing the forearm: the dent and contact pressure from a soft-tissue solve

hint.zh: 直径 26 mm 的平头压头压入前臂中段 4.5 mm（forearm2026 的做法）：后台约 12 秒解出软组织，凹陷边算边出现，平均接触压强交给疼痛模型。与文献对照过：这里 1.83 N，是实测 2.83 N 的 0.65 倍
hint.en: A 26 mm flat punch pressed 4.5 mm into the mid-forearm (the forearm2026 protocol): the soft tissue is solved in the background in about 12 s, the dent forms as it solves, and the mean contact pressure goes to the pain model. Compared with the literature: 1.83 N here, 0.65 of the 2.83 N measured

title.zh: 躺下：软组织在重力下的下垂（未经实测验证）
title.en: Lying down: soft tissue sagging under gravity (not validated against measurements)

hint.zh: 重力转向背侧，全身软组织笼子在后台走到平衡（CPU 上约 80 秒），然后皮肤按相对站立的位移着色并移动。可以换俯卧、侧卧。没有与实测数据对照过
hint.en: Gravity turns to the back and the whole-body soft-tissue cage settles in the background (about 80 s on CPU); then the skin is coloured by, and moves with, its displacement relative to standing. Try prone or lying on a side. Not compared with measured data

title.zh: 消化道的腔：从口到肛门连成一条
title.en: The alimentary lumen: one channel from mouth to anus

hint.zh: 壁画成半透明，腔用蓝色。腔不是扫描的：由器官外表面向内缩一个文献壁厚推出来，构造的部分另用颜色标出。拖“充盈”看腔从静止（食管和胃塌陷、小肠很细）撑到壁允许的最大；壁不跟着动
hint.en: Walls are see-through and the lumina blue. They are not scanned: each is the organ’s outer surface moved inward by a literature wall thickness, with construction coloured apart. Drag “充盈” (filling) from rest (oesophagus and stomach collapsed, small bowel thin) to as full as the wall allows; the walls do not move

title.zh: 胃的充盈：从塌陷到撑满
title.en: Filling the stomach: from collapsed to distended

hint.zh: 只留胃和它的腔。拖“充盈”滑块：静止时约 20 cm³，撑满约 440 cm³（由网格算出的近似值）。胃静止时的形状是假设；胃壁在模型里不随充盈移动
hint.en: The stomach and its cavity alone. Drag the “充盈” (filling) slider: about 20 cm³ at rest and about 440 cm³ full (approximations computed from the mesh). The resting shape is an assumption, and the wall does not move with filling in this model

title.zh: 内镜漫游：从食管一路走下去
title.en: Fly-through: down the canal from the oesophagus

hint.zh: 相机在腔里面沿中心线前进，底下显示所在的段和已走的距离；可以暂停、反向、调速、拖动位置。漫游时各段至少充盈到 0.5，窄于 6 毫米处被撑开（只为看得见，不是数据）；食管入胃、回肠入升结肠处相机会离开腔走一小段，小肠的急弯处会擦出腔外
hint.en: The camera travels inside the lumen along its centreline; the strip below names the segment and the distance covered, with pause, reverse, speed and a scrubber. While flying every segment is filled to at least 0.5 and anything narrower than 6 mm is widened (only to be visible; not data); where the oesophagus enters the stomach and the ileum the colon the camera leaves the lumen briefly, and it grazes outside at sharp bends of the small bowel

summary.zh: 三维人体解剖（教学用模型，不是临床依据）：男性 3,332 个、女性 3,369 个解剖部件（带概念编号，多数是 FMA 编号），8,760 条关系（起止点、神经支配、血供等），中文名称，关节活动度，皮节和皮神经分布区。主要是数据；可以调用的计算有一个：tts，把一句英语或普通话合成语音并给出音素时间线（机器合成的声音）。全部名称和关系都未经人工审校。查"某块肌肉由什么神经支配"：先在 parts 里按英文名找到它的 fma 字段，再在 relations 里用 key=<fma>&where=kind=innervatedBy。
summary.en: 3D human anatomy (a teaching model, not a clinical reference): 3,332 male and 3,369 female anatomical parts (each with a concept id, mostly an FMA id), 8,760 relations (origins, insertions, innervation, blood supply and more), Chinese names, joint ranges of motion, dermatomes and cutaneous nerve territories. Mostly data; there is one computation to call: `tts`, which synthesizes one English or Mandarin sentence and returns a phoneme timeline (machine-generated audio). No name or relation has been reviewed by a person. To answer "which nerve innervates this muscle": find the `fma` field of the part in `parts` by English name, then query `relations` with key=<fma>&where=kind=innervatedBy.

title.zh: 解剖部件
title.en: Anatomical parts

description.zh: 男性身体模型里的每一个部件：名称、概念编号（fma 字段；多数是 FMA 编号，少数是本项目为没有 FMA 类的结构起的编号，如 ZAC_…，左右成对的写作 FMA…_L/_R）、所属系统、组织类型、左右、剥离层、体积（立方厘米，部分部件没有）、相邻部件。
description.en: Every part of the male body model: name, concept id (the `fma` field; mostly an FMA id, a few are ids this project coined for structures without an FMA class, e.g. ZAC_…, and sided pairs are written FMA…_L/_R), system, tissue type, side, peel depth, volume (cm³, absent on some parts) and adjacent parts.

datasets.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the dataset as a whole; upstream sources are CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 2.1 JP, CC BY-SA 4.0 and Apache-2.0, listed under `sources` in the file

provenance.zh: 几何来自 BodyParts3D 4.0 和 3.0、Z-Anatomy、Open3DModel，皮肤是按内部结构拟合的参数化体表（MHR），逐个来源和许可见该文件的 sources 字段。provenance 字段：scanned 是来自真实人体数据的重建；warped 是经配准或姿势校正变形过的；curated 是人工建模、拟合或由本项目推导的。文件的 cautions 字段列出了已知的错误和缺失，引用前应先读。没有经过医学专业人员审校。
provenance.en: Geometry from BodyParts3D 4.0 and 3.0, Z-Anatomy and Open3DModel; the skin is a parametric surface (MHR) fitted to the internals; every source and licence is listed under `sources` in the file. The `provenance` field: `scanned` is reconstructed from real human data; `warped` was deformed by registration or posture correction; `curated` is artist-modelled, fitted or derived by this project. The file's `cautions` list known errors and omissions and should be read before quoting anything. Not reviewed by medical professionals.

title.zh: 解剖部件（女性）
title.en: Anatomical parts (female)

description.zh: 女性身体模型里的每一个部件，字段同 parts。比男性模型粗糙得多。
description.en: Every part of the female body model, same fields as `parts`. Far coarser than the male model.

datasets.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the dataset as a whole; upstream sources (CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA, Apache-2.0, NLM terms with attribution) are listed under `sources` in the file

provenance.zh: 没有一个部件是 scanned：骨架来自 Visible Human 女性 CT 但按标准比例缩放过；下肢肌肉来自丹佛大学的数据；盆底、阴道、子宫、附件来自另一位女性的标本（Wu 等 2015）；其余大部分是从男性模型配准变形而来，并按标准女性体表调整过软组织分布。皮肤目前是占位。文件的 cautions 字段列出了已知问题。没有经过医学专业人员审校。
provenance.en: No part is `scanned`: the skeleton is from the Visible Human Female CT but rescaled to standard proportions; leg muscles are from the University of Denver data; pelvic floor, vagina, uterus and adnexa are from another woman's specimen (Wu et al. 2015); most of the rest was warped from the male model and its soft-tissue distribution adjusted toward a standard female body surface. The skin is a placeholder for now. The file's `cautions` list the known problems. Not reviewed by medical professionals.

title.zh: 解剖关系
title.en: Anatomical relations

description.zh: 三元组：subject（FMA 编号）—kind—object。kind 有 origin、insertion、innervatedBy、innervates、arterialSupply、venousDrainage、antagonist、connectsWith、lymphaticDrainage。key 是 subject，所以 key=FMA… 给出这个部件的全部关系。
description.en: Triples: subject (an FMA id) — kind — object. Kinds are origin, insertion, innervatedBy, innervates, arterialSupply, venousDrainage, antagonist, connectsWith, lymphaticDrainage. The key is the subject, so key=FMA… returns every relation of that part.

datasets.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (each record carries its own source licence: 8,151 are CC0 1.0 from Wikidata, 609 are CC BY-SA 4.0 from Wikipedia and Z-Anatomy)

provenance.zh: 每条带 source（名称、网址、许可）。**全部 8,760 条的 status 都是 unreviewed**：是从 Wikidata 等来源机器汇集的，没有经人逐条核对；有些是从整块肌肉推到它的分部的，source 里会写明。
provenance.en: Each record carries its source (name, URL, licence). **All 8,760 have status `unreviewed`**: they were gathered by machine from Wikidata and other sources and not checked one by one by a person; some were propagated from a whole muscle to its parts, which the source text says.

title.zh: 中文名称
title.en: Chinese names

description.zh: 按概念编号（即 parts 的 fma 字段）给出中文名和 Wikidata 条目，共 5,441 个概念。英文名在 parts 的 name 字段里。
description.en: Chinese name and Wikidata item for each of 5,441 concepts, keyed by concept id (the `fma` field of `parts`). English names are in the `name` field of `parts`.

provenance.zh: zhSource 字段写明每个中文名的来历：3,638 个是按术语表机器生成的（machine-translation），682 个是由别的名称推导的（derived），574 个取自术语表（lexicon），547 个来自 Wikidata。全部 status 都是 unreviewed。
provenance.en: `zhSource` states where each Chinese name comes from: 3,638 are machine-generated from a term lexicon (`machine-translation`), 682 derived from other names, 574 from the lexicon and 547 from Wikidata. Every entry has status `unreviewed`.

title.zh: 关节活动度
title.en: Joint ranges of motion

description.zh: 每个自由度正负两个方向的活动范围（度），带来源和可信程度。
description.en: The range in each direction (degrees) for every degree of freedom, with its source and how reliable it is.

provenance.zh: source 字段指向文件里 sources 表的一项；status 是 estimate 的是估计值，不是测量值。
provenance.en: The `source` field points into the `sources` table of the file; entries with status `estimate` are estimates, not measurements.

title.zh: 皮节
title.en: Dermatomes

description.zh: 31 个皮节区：名称、依据、划分规则、引用。
description.en: The 31 dermatome regions: name, basis, rule and citations.

provenance.zh: cite 指向文件里 sources 表；不同教科书的皮节图互相有出入，文件的 scheme 字段说明了采用哪一套以及偏离之处。这是按规则构造的教学用图，皮节因人而异；未经审校。
provenance.en: `cite` points into the `sources` table of the file; dermatome maps differ between textbooks, and the `scheme` field of the file says which one is followed and where it deviates. This is a rule-constructed teaching map and dermatomes vary between people; not reviewed.

title.zh: 皮神经分布区
title.en: Cutaneous nerve territories

description.zh: 49 个皮神经分布区：名称、对应的脊髓节段及其出处、分布范围的文字描述及其出处、上级神经。
description.en: The 49 cutaneous nerve territories: name, spinal segments with their source, a text description of the territory with its source, and the parent nerves.

provenance.zh: segmentsSource 和 territorySource 指向文件里 sources 表（主要是 Gray 1918）。分布区在模型体表上的划分是按规则构造的，有些与皮节图不一致，文件和 README 里有说明；未经审校。
provenance.en: `segmentsSource` and `territorySource` point into the `sources` table of the file (mainly Gray 1918). How the territories are drawn on the model's skin is rule-constructed and some disagree with the dermatome map, as the file and its README explain; not reviewed.

title.zh: 把一句话合成语音，带音素时间线
title.en: Synthesize one sentence, with a phoneme timeline

description.zh: 用开源模型 Kokoro（Apache-2.0；英语 v1.0，普通话 v1.1-zh）在后端把一句英语或普通话合成语音，返回 base64 的 WAV（24 kHz、单声道、16 位）和音素时间线：每个音的起止时间（秒）。英语的 phone 是 ARPAbet（重音另放在 stress：0 无、1 主、2 次；另有 AX、IX、DX 三个扩展音素），普通话的 phone 是拼音的声母和韵母（ü 写作 v，声调另放在 tone，儿化是单独的一段 r），停顿是 sil；symbol 是模型自己的记号。还返回每个词的起止时间和模型的名称、版本、许可。时间线来自模型的时长预测器（每 25 毫秒一格），不是事后从声音里猜的；塞音处与声音的偏差中位数约 10 毫秒。同样的输入得到同样的字节。声音最长 13 秒，超过会报错并说明怎么改。不调用语言模型，请求时不联网。声音是机器合成的，不是真人录音。
description.en: Synthesizes one English or Mandarin sentence on the backend with the open model Kokoro (Apache-2.0; v1.0 for English, v1.1-zh for Mandarin) and returns a base64 WAV (24 kHz, mono, 16-bit) with a phoneme timeline: the start and end of every sound in seconds. English `phone` values are ARPAbet (stress is separate in `stress`: 0 none, 1 primary, 2 secondary; plus the extended phones AX, IX and DX); Mandarin `phone` values are pinyin initials and finals (ü is written v, the tone is separate in `tone`, erhua is a separate stretch `r`); a pause is `sil`; `symbol` is the model's own symbol. Word start and end times and the model's name, version and licence are returned too. The timeline comes from the model's duration predictor (25 ms steps), not from guesses about the audio; at stops it is off from the audio by a median of about 10 ms. The same input gives the same bytes. Audio is capped at 13 s; longer requests are refused with a message saying how to fix them. No language model is called and nothing goes to the network at request time. The audio is machine-generated, not a recording of a person.

text.description: 要读的文字，1 到 300 个字符。lang 为 en 时是英文；为 zh 时是汉字（数字会读成中文，不能夹拉丁字母）。合成出的声音超过 13 秒会报错，请缩短。 / The text to speak, 1 to 300 characters. English for lang en; Chinese characters for lang zh (digits are read in Chinese; Latin letters are not accepted). Audio longer than 13 s is refused: shorten the text.

lang.description: 语言：en 英语（美式），zh 普通话。 / Language: en English (American), zh Mandarin.

voice.description: 声音；不给就用这种语言的默认声音。英语：af_heart、af_bella、am_michael、am_fenrir；普通话：zf_001、zf_002、zm_010、zm_009。 / Voice; the language's default when omitted. English: af_heart, af_bella, am_michael, am_fenrir; Mandarin: zf_001, zf_002, zm_010, zm_009.

speed.description: 语速倍数，0.5 到 2，默认 1。 / Speaking rate multiplier, 0.5 to 2; default 1.

output.zh: { sampleRate, durationS, lang, voice, speed, audio（base64 的 WAV）, audioFormat, phonemes: [{ t0, t1, phone, symbol, word, stress | part + tone }], words: [{ t0, t1, text }], symbols, warnings, model: { name, version, licence, source, commit } }。出错时是 { detail, field, allowed }。
output.en: { sampleRate, durationS, lang, voice, speed, audio (base64 WAV), audioFormat, phonemes: [{ t0, t1, phone, symbol, word, stress | part + tone }], words: [{ t0, t1, text }], symbols, warnings, model: { name, version, licence, source, commit } }. On error: { detail, field, allowed }.

example.text: Please bring five more books before noon.
